Harley G.bio: Harley G is a Canadian hip-hop artist and Oshawa figure whose recording catalogue includes the 2024 single 'I Wont Change' with Snow and Young Stitch, released through Shark Tank Recordings. The performing identity connects directly to Harley Davidson Guindon, known locally through the Harley G's brand in Oshawa and documented as having been born in Oshawa, Ontario. His music activity is rooted in the Durham Region scene, including Ontario tour appearances alongside Merkules, Icarus and Young Stitch.
